newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary approves Zwack Frankfurt listing.
newsitem.headline: Hungary approves Zwack Frankfurt listing.

text.p: Hungary's Securities and Bourse Supervision approved spirits maker Zwack Unikum Rt's request for listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, the official bourse gazette said on Friday.
Zwack's IAS operating profit in the first half of 1996 was 378 million forints on net gross sales of 6.307 billion and net sales of 3.609 billion.
The group achieved an operating profit of 216 million forints in the same six months of 1995 when its gross sales amounted to 5.226 billion while net sales reached 2.751 billion.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange (closed until January 6) Zwack shares closed on December 20, the last day of trading, at 2,700 forints, up 25.
Zwack officials were not immediately available for comment.
